selection.text: Volumes climbed steadily through the first half of the year. A short dip in March matched the
planned maintenance window. By June the network was moving more freight than ever before.

selection.text: Cost per crate is now the main measure the board watches. Fuel and wages make up most of
that cost. Rent is fixed until the leases end.
